dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: Ah, hello. I've been continuing to practice the Melody of Vesta recently...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you played it for Mamere?

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: N—Not yet, I'm afraid. I mean, she's often out of the village, and no one can find her when that happens.

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: But when she's around, I also feel kinda... embarrassed... This song's supposed to be a gift, after all. I have to practice a few more times...

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: But I'll find a chance to play for her. I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got something else to attend to at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: Alright. Go do what you have to first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the song to be played for Mamere...

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: Oh! I finally played it for her as a farewell gift when she left the village to travel!

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: She said she could see tall towers and gorgeous ships as it played in her ear...

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: And she even mentioned the probability of creating a masterpiece based on it! She never ceases to impress!

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: Anyway, I owe you my thanks! I couldn't have made such a precious memory without your help!
